claims.content: The C2 JU publishes Ballistic Missile Surveillance Reports to provide targeting and threat warning information among systems involved in joint operations, ensuring the information is complete, accurate, timely, correlated, and follows proper reporting rules.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU publishes Ballistic Missile Surveillance Reports to provide targeting and threat warning information among systems involved in joint operations, ensuring the information is complete, accurate, timely, correlated, and follows proper reporting rules.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU must have assumed R² (Reporting Responsibility) for the ballistic missile track in accordance with R² rules specified in paragraph 4.4.6.15.
The C2 JU must have continuously correlated locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG to identify uncorrelated local tracks.

The C2 JU must have resolved any detected information differences (e.g., Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform) between local data and data reported on the interface, typically by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.
If integrating PPLI reports, the C2 JU must have performed applicable correlation and conflict processing to ensure duplicative information is not transmitted.
The C2 JU identifies an uncorrelated local ballistic missile track and assumes Reporting Responsibility (R2) for it.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU identifies an uncorrelated local ballistic missile track and assumes Reporting Responsibility (R2) for it.

claims.content: If a conflict is detected between locally derived information and information reported on the interface, the C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
A JU relinquishes Reporting Responsibility (R²) for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with Track Quality (TQ) greater than local TQ.

A JU relinquishes Reporting Responsibility (R²) for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.

If position or other data in a PPLI report meets a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated, and the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
The information on the ballistic missile track/point is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.
Data are correlated and dual designation is minimized.
The proper rules for reporting a ballistic missile track/point are followed.
